notes.title: Port Town Survival Update Notes
notes.content:
A new update has arrived! We've fixed some bugs and made improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here are the details:

🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:
✅ Various bug fixes for a smoother game experience!
✅ AI enemies now have reduced health, making battles more balanced!
✅ German language support has been added! You can now play the game in German.

Your feedback is invaluable to us! We will continue improving the game based on your suggestions. Happy sailing! 🚢🔥

notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes & Russian Language Issue Resolved!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We've just rolled out a new update with important improvements:

- Bug Fixes – Various in-game issues have been resolved for a smoother experience.
- Russian Language Fix – The Russian localization issue has been addressed, ensuring better translation and readability.
Thank you for your support! Keep the feedback coming, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: 🔥 Port Town Survival – Pre-Early Access Live Stream! 🔥
notes.content:
As Port Town Survival prepares for Early Access, dive into an exclusive live stream and explore the game's world! 🌍🚢

🎮 What to Expect in the Live Stream?
🔹 First-ever gameplay footage and mechanics
🔹 Story details and the importance of mysterious photos
🔹 Steam achievements and survival tips
🔹 Live Q&A with the developer!

Are you ready to uncover the secrets and fight for survival? Join us on this adventure! 🔥

notes.title: Port Town: Survival Gameplay
notes.content:
Port Town: Survival Gameplay

After a mysterious disaster, you find yourself struggling to survive in a port town. Port Town awaits you with its mysterious secrets and challenges. An exciting adventure that will test all your survival skills is about to begin!
